title: phoradendron bolleanum subsp. pauciflorum
intro:
Phoradendron bolleanum subsp. pauciflorum, commonly known as the "Yellow Cedar", is a species of mistletoe that grows on cedar trees in Mexico and Central America. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can aid in reducing pain and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Phoradendron bolleanum subsp. pauciflorum include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
